description: This file defines the CacheableNormalization class in the Drupal JSON:API module, responsible for storing normalized data along with cacheability metadata, providing methods for cache dependency management, normalization retrieval, and aggregation of multiple normalizations.

classes.name: CacheableNormalization
classes.description: A class for storing normalized data with cacheability metadata, supporting cache dependency management and data aggregation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CacheableNormalization instance with cacheability metadata and normalized data.

methods.name: permanent
methods.description: Creates a CacheableNormalization instance with default cacheability.

methods.name: omitIfEmpty
methods.description: Converts to CacheableOmission if normalization is empty.

methods.name: withCacheableDependency
methods.description: Returns a new CacheableNormalization with an added cache dependency.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Combines multiple CacheableNormalizations into one, merging cacheability and normalizations.

methods.name: hasNoNestedInstances
methods.description: Checks recursively that no nested values are instances of CacheableNormalization.
